Just rub some meat in salt and cook it for a simple, tasty dish.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Salt-Grilled Meats by [[Cooking]] either [[Raw Meat]] or a [[Raw Bird Drumstick]] with [[Rock Salt]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. By eating them, some of Link's [[Heart]]s can be restored. These [[Meal]]s are known to be easily made when one is short on [[Ingredient]]s, since preparing them only requires the [[Meat]] to be rubbed in salt. Additional Ingredients can be used when making Salt-Grilled Meats, which results in the following variations: * '''Hearty Salt-Grilled Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Salt-Grilled Meat}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Short on ingredients? Just rub some meat in salt and cook it for a simple, tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. These will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts when eaten. * '''Energizing Salt-Grilled Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Salt-Grilled Meat}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Short on ingredients? Just rub some meat in salt and cook it for a simple, tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. When eaten, they will partially refill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Enduring Salt-Grilled Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Salt-Grilled Meat}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Short on ingredients? Just rub some meat in salt and cook it for a simple, tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. Link's Stamina Wheel will be completely restored and overfilled if he eats them. * '''Hasty Salt-Grilled Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Salt-Grilled Meat}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Short on ingredients? Just rub some meat in salt and cook it for a simple, tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. If they're consumed, Link's movement speed will be increased. * '''Spicy Salt-Grilled Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Salt-Grilled Meat}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Short on ingredients? Just rub some meat in salt and cook it for a simple, tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. When eaten, they will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Salt-Grilled Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Salt-Grilled Meat}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Short on ingredients? Just rub some meat in salt and cook it for a simple, tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. These can be eaten for Link to gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Salt-Grilled Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Salt-Grilled Meat}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Short on ingredients? Just rub some meat in salt and cook it for a simple, tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. By eating them, the power of Link's attacks will be increased. * '''Tough Salt-Grilled Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Salt-Grilled Meat}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Short on ingredients? Just rub some meat in salt and cook it for a simple, tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. Link can eat them to receive a boost to his defensive abilities. * '''Sneaky Salt-Grilled Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Salt-Grilled Meat}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Short on ingredients? Just rub some meat in salt and cook it for a simple, tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. When eaten, they will grant Link a boost to his [[Stealth]] abilities. * '''Chilly Salt-Grilled Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Salt-Grilled Meat}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Short on ingredients? Just rub some meat in salt and cook it for a simple, tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly Ingredients. They can be eaten to grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Salt-Grilled Meats are a type of [[Meal]] that can be made by [[Cooking]] a piece of [[Rock Salt]] with either [[Raw Meat]] or a [[Raw Bird Drumstick]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat * Salt-Grilled Prime Meat }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Salt-Grilled Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
